brief: 6 simple productivity tips from a designer who built a 7-figure studio. Calm, editorial tone. No bullshit.

slots.headline: Six productivity rules that built a seven-figure studio

slots.title: Protect Your Mornings
slots.body: The first three hours are your most honest. Guard them for deep work and avoid the inbox until noon. Everything else can wait.

slots.title: Batch Shallow Tasks
slots.body: Stop fragmenting your day with emails and Slack. Cluster administrative work into a single afternoon block. Momentum lives in long, uninterrupted stretches.

slots.title: Default to No
slots.body: Every yes is a silent no to your own priorities. If an opportunity does not move the studio forward, decline with grace. Your calendar is a creative asset.

slots.title: Curate Your Space
slots.body: Clutter is visual noise. A clean desk signals a clear mind. Invest in one beautiful tool rather than ten mediocre ones. Environment shapes output.

slots.title: Review on Fridays
slots.body: Daily to-do lists breed anxiety. A single weekly review lets you align tasks with larger goals. Step back to see the forest, not just the trees.

slots.title: Rest Without Guilt
slots.body: Burnout is not a badge of honor. Scheduled rest restores judgment and prevents expensive mistakes. A well-rested designer moves faster than an exhausted one.
